summary: Pytest imports depended on the caller working directory.
cause: Project root was not guaranteed on sys.path when tests were launched by absolute path.
fix: Added pyproject.toml with pytest pythonpath and testpaths configuration.

summary: Static action marker did not protect localhost API from hostile browser origins or DNS rebinding.
fix: Added strict local Host validation, same-origin Origin validation, per-process HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie, mutation marker as defense-in-depth, protected all /api endpoints, CSP/X-Frame-Options/nosniff headers.

summary: WebSocket event stream accepted foreign browser origins.
fix: WebSocket now requires local Host, exact same-origin Origin and the per-process session cookie before accept().

summary: Pytest was installed and executed on every normal application start.
fix: Removed pytest/httpx from runtime dependencies; normal bootstrap performs only a lightweight import check. Developer tests use a separate dev venv and requirements-dev.lock.

summary: Dependency cache key was only requirements hash and could incorrectly survive interpreter replacement.
fix: deps.state.json now binds requirements hash to interpreter executable SHA-256, Python version and environment kind; failed runtime imports force reinstall.

summary: Bootstrap selected Python dynamically and could pick an undesired release.
fix: Portable runtime is pinned via PYTHON_VERSION to stable Python 3.13.16 and downloaded from its exact python.org release path.

summary: Restart reused the previous port and watchdog could retry indefinitely every two seconds after repeated failure.
fix: Restart waits for old server termination, reselects a free port, updates tray/runtime state and applies exponential watchdog retry backoff up to 60 seconds.

summary: Uvicorn default logging could depend on stderr under pythonw.exe.
fix: Uvicorn is created with log_config=None and application logs continue through the rotating file logger.

summary: runtime.json could remain stale and second launch could open a dead port.
fix: Second launch validates recorded PID and TCP port before opening; runtime.json is deleted on shutdown and final cleanup.

summary: Live events lacked database timestamps and UI refetched event history on every WebSocket event.
fix: EventHub uses one UTC timestamp for DB and WebSocket; UI appends live events locally, polls status every 3 seconds and refreshes history every 30 seconds.

summary: Corrupt or invalid settings could be silently replaced or retain invalid types.
fix: Settings are validated and normalized; corrupt JSON is copied to a timestamped evidence file before defaults are rewritten; unsafe host values are forced to 127.0.0.1.

summary: Recovery could select an invalid backup and backups had no retention policy.
fix: Current DB is health-checked before migration backup; restore scans newest-to-oldest for a valid backup; new backups are verified and rotated to configured retention.

summary: Windows PowerShell 5.1 could misread UTF-8 paths and hidden PowerShell startup could flash a console.
fix: Autostart PowerShell is UTF-8 BOM; a small ASCII VBS launcher starts it hidden. Instance marker is generated locally and matched by value across drive-letter changes.

summary: Tray restart/exit callbacks could block the tray UI thread.
fix: Potentially blocking tray actions now execute on daemon worker threads.

summary: Console callbacks, diagnose port, duplicate version strings, static service badges, hash routing and autostart toggle behavior were inconsistent.
fix: Console restart/shutdown callbacks implemented; diagnose reads runtime.json and validates PID/TCP; VERSION is sole project-version source; service badges are API-driven; hashchange and stable async toggle behavior added.

summary: Instance marker was committed and dependency versions were ranged.
fix: Removed committed marker and ignored it; marker is generated per installation; runtime and dev dependency sets are exactly pinned in separate lock files.

summary: SQLite context-manager usage committed transactions but left connection handles open until garbage collection, locking WAL and backup files on Windows.
root_cause: sqlite3.Connection.__exit__ does not close the connection.
fix: Added explicit managed session lifecycle and explicit close paths; Windows regression tests now pass.

summary: Windows PowerShell 5.1 parser failed on UTF-8 PowerShell scripts containing Cyrillic when files had no BOM.
root_cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 does not reliably interpret UTF-8-without-BOM source files as UTF-8.
fix: PowerShell scripts are stored with UTF-8 BOM and validated by Windows PowerShell parser in CI.

summary: Failed diagnostics left status 'Тестирование' and concurrent runs overwrote each other.
fix: try/finally status reset, lock with HTTP 409, error response, UI handling.

summary: Restart/shutdown callbacks ran before the HTTP response was delivered.
fix: Callbacks deferred by 0.2s via threading.Timer.

summary: Restart could change port and strand open browser tabs.
fix: Restart prefers the current port, falls back to configured range.

summary: trim_events ran a DELETE on every emit.
fix: Trim on first emit and then every 50 events.

summary: Port could be taken between probe and bind.
fix: start_server retries on a new port up to 3 times.

summary: Offline state failed full diagnostics.
fix: Internet check is non-critical.

summary: Read-only media crashed startup when writing instance marker.
fix: Marker creation errors are tolerated at startup.

summary: Kohakuyasha.bat did not start on Windows.
root_cause: BAT files were UTF-8 with Cyrillic and LF endings (cmd.exe mis-parses); %~dp0 trailing backslash escaped the closing quote of -Root; embedded Python ._pth runs isolated so 'core' was not importable.
fix: ASCII CRLF batch files, KOH_ROOT=%~dp0. without trailing backslash, pause on failure, .gitattributes eol rules, sys.path bootstrap in launcher.pyw/main.py, regression tests.

summary: /ws/events returned 404 because no WebSocket library (websockets/wsproto) was installed with uvicorn, so the live event stream silently fell back to polling.
root_cause: requirements.lock pinned uvicorn without websockets; found by real-browser smoke test.
fix: Pinned websockets==17.2 in requirements.lock; removed invalid ws://[::1]:* CSP source.

summary: app.css header rule contained a typo (displax:flex) so page headers never became flex, and its margin leaked into panel headers.
fix: Fixed to display:flex; panel headers reset margin.

summary: Clock seconds were invisible: an inline child with opacity inside a background-clip:text parent renders transparent.
fix: Seconds use an explicit text fill colour without opacity.

summary: First Stop implementation relied on request.is_disconnected(), which does not fire behind the BaseHTTPMiddleware, so a stopped answer was still stored.
root_cause: Disconnect detection is unreliable with BaseHTTPMiddleware; found by a real-browser test with a slow fake provider.
fix: Explicit /api/chat/cancel with a per-request id; the answer of a cancelled request is discarded (unit-tested).

summary: Clock and calendar resized continuously with the window (vw-based font, aspect-ratio cells, percentage columns), so they appeared to drift on wide or maximised windows.
fix: Fixed pixel sizes for clock and calendar cells, fixed-width side column, max content width, container query for the notes column.

summary: The 'full picture' avatar showed black corners because the source image is a circle on a black square.
fix: avatar-full.png has a transparent background (flood-filled corners, feathered edge); full mode uses object-fit: contain.
